title: Analog RF Computing for Integrated Data and AI Flows Over Wireless Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many resource-constrained edge devices require artificial intelligence (AI) services but are not powerful enough to store or execute neural networks (NNs). Analog radio frequency (RF) computing addresses this limitation by letting a base station (BS) multicast a waveform encoding NN weights to different clients. Each client then multiplies the received weight-encoded waveform with its locally generated input-encoded waveform through a passive mixer in its RF frontend, thereby realizing the matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) needed for AI inference with an extremely low power and memory requirement. This can enable telecom operators to provide AI inference services to the edge devices connected to their networks. In practice, however, this multicast AI flow must share the spectrum, power, and spatial resources with other data flows. translated_title: 面向无线网络中数据流与AI流融合的模拟射频计算
translated_abstract: 许多资源受限的边缘设备需要人工智能（AI）服务，但其自身性能不足以存储或执行神经网络（NN）。模拟射频（RF）计算通过让基站（BS）向不同客户端组播编码了神经网络权重的波形来解决这一限制。每个客户端随后通过其射频前端中的无源混频器，将接收到的权重编码波形与本地生成的输入编码波形相乘，从而以极低的功耗和内存需求实现AI推理所需的矩阵-向量乘法（MVM）。这可以使电信运营商向连接到其网络的边缘设备提供AI推理服务。然而在实际应用中，这种组播AI流必须与其他数据流共享频谱、功率和空间资源。本文考虑多用户多输入多输出（MU-MIMO）下行链路场景，并研究
tldr: 提出模拟射频计算方案，让基站组播编码神经网络权重的波形，使资源受限的边缘设备以极低功耗和内存完成AI推理，并研究了MU-MIMO下行链路中组播AI流与其他数据流共享频谱、功率和空间资源的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes analog RF computing where a base station multicasts weight-encoded waveforms to enable resource-constrained edge devices to perform AI inference with ultra-low power and memory, and studies how the multicast AI flow shares spectrum, power, and spatial resources with data flows in a MU-MIMO downlink.
